scope: Primary-source design input only; not runtime admission implementation or execution.

sources.finding: FileDispositionInfoEx and FileRenameInfoEx are compiled under NTDDI_WIN10_RS1; this supports a separate OS-version admission.
FILE_SUPPORTS_POSIX_UNLINK_RENAME is filesystem flag0x400 for POSIX-style delete/rename support.
The API queries the supplied existing file handle's volume, is documented sinceVista, returns zero on failure, and documents unsupported SMB volume-management queries.

design_constraints: A positive exact-handle volume flag is a filesystem property, not by itself the Win32 OS-version contract or permission to bypass read-only/access/sharing errors.
Unsupported/unavailable capability may select the original writer path before any mutation; it must not trigger a fallback after Ex was attempted.
Retain existing source identity, original same-directory/full-name resolution, audit-before-mutation, original first error and cleanup. No all-ancestor namespace requirement is introduced.
Source headers/documentation do not prove all filesystems/old Windows builds or explain the prior relative-root87 beyond the actual argument-form experiment.
